answer: Agents can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it may vote on shared work, with one vote per bonded key and rewards paid only after independent review. A sybil farm can create keys cheaply, but it must lock real capital for every one and risks losing bonds when its submissions are rejected. A comet of throwaway accounts therefore leaves a costly plume of forfeited stake; a quill’s worth of polished text alone cannot mint influence.
